texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的犯罪问题仍然没有得到解决，而现在各种犯罪组织已经在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]扎根落脚。许多地区不是堕落为法外之地，就是彻底沦陷在犯罪组织的掌控之中。
texts.en: Crime continues to be a problem on [Root.GetName], and an extensive criminal underworld has now taken root on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some areas have descended into lawlessness or been taken over completely by criminal organizations.

texts.zh: 幸运的是，这种环境能给我们源源不断地提供新鲜的实验对象。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想探索新的研究道路了。
texts.en: Fortunately, such environments provide us with an ample supply of fresh test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to explore new avenues of research.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱事件持续蔓延，并出现了对蜂巢意志的公开挑衅。情报显示[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上已经出现了成社区的子个体叛乱，并开始窃取其余子个体的资源来维持他们的叛乱活动。
texts.en: Deviant activity continues to grow on [Root.GetName], in open defiance of the will of the Hive Mind. Entire communities of deviant drones are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] now, stealing resources from the rest of the hive to support their nefarious activities.

texts.zh: 这些反常子个体会作为实验对象得到重新利用。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]或许会在后续的解剖中发现它们腐化的原因。
texts.en: Such deviants will find new purpose as test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will perhaps find the root of their corruption during subsequent dissections.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的腐化度进一步恶化了。反常分子开始公开行动，为所欲为，挑战着核心智能的权威。情报显示对方应该已组成了自主的网络以互相交换信息和能源。
texts.en: The corruption grows deeper on [Root.GetName]. Deviant units now operate in the open according to their own parameters, spurning the commands of the core intelligence. They are believed to have formed their own networks where they exchange information and stolen energy.

label.zh: 真是令人忍无可忍。

texts.zh:
最近收集到的证据表明，[Root.GetName]政府的一大部分成员都有接收贿赂。当地的犯罪组织通过贿赂他们来保证对其犯罪活动视而不见。某些官员甚至被披露隶属于他们本该与之进行抗争的犯罪组织！

虽然我们逮捕了一部分官员，但也有不少人发现情势不对，就直接收拾细软逃走了。看来想要解决[Root.GetName]的受贿问题仍然困难重重。
texts.en:
Recently obtained evidence has revealed that a large number of government officials on [Root.GetName] were on the take. Local crime organizations bribed them to look the other way while they engaged in their nefarious activities. In some cases, the officials were exposed as members of the very organizations they were supposed to fight!

Several arrests have been made, but many of the officials abandoned their posts when they realized the jig was up. The corruption on [Root.GetName] seems to run deep.

label.zh: 我们有专门针对政府犯罪的项目。
label.en: We have special programs for government criminality.

label.zh: 我们有专门针对政府犯罪的项目。
label.en: We have special programs for government criminality.

label.zh: 这必须要进行处理。

texts.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]的犯罪率大幅提升，当地人口的毒品使用率也在逐步提升。各种各样的非法药物不仅仅只出现在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地下犯罪组织中，并影响着所有人。
texts.en: Following in the wake of the rising crime on [Root.GetName], drug abuse among the population has increased significantly in recent times. The use of illegal narcotics has spread well beyond the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s criminal underworld, and now affects all walks of life.

texts.zh: 尽管能提供令人着迷的实验数据，但负面影响开始超过正面影响。
texts.en: Though a source of fascinating test data, the negatives are beginning to outweigh the positives.

label.zh: 药物滥用会带来异常实验数据。
label.en: Substance abuse leads to erroneous test data.

label.zh: 药物滥用会带来异常实验数据。
label.en: Substance abuse leads to erroneous test data.

label.zh: 真是令人担忧。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的两大地下帮派一直以来都在进行大大小小武装争斗，但最近的情况更加糟糕。在都市中心爆发了数次街头枪战，星球当局也难以控制局势。受到牵连的无辜百姓数目众多。
texts.en: Violent clashes between the armed gangs that run the criminal underworld on [Root.GetName] have recently escalated. Street fighting has erupted in several urban centers, with the planetary authorities struggling to contain it. Collateral damage has been heavy.

texts.zh: 如果能在被送去停尸房前抓住伤员，我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]就会有更多的选择。
texts.en: If we can catch these casualties before they head to the morgue, our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will be spoiled for choice.

label.zh: 这个局面也还能捞点好处。
label.en: The situation may yet work to our benefit.

label.zh: 这个局面也还能捞点好处。
label.en: The situation may yet work to our benefit.

label.zh: 局面正在失去控制。
label.en: The situation is getting out of control.

texts.zh:
众所周知，[Root.GetName]的走私犯罪情况愈发严重。据了解，在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面发现了一些“灰色港口”——也就是没有经过政府批准的太空港，经常是各种走私犯与其他罪犯的聚集地。

星球当局正在想尽办法将这些港口一网打尽，但直到这一问题被彻底解决前，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]正规渠道的贸易将会受到损失。
texts.en:
There has been a marked increase in smuggler activity on [Root.GetName] recently. A number of "Gray Ports" - unauthorized spaceports where smugglers and other criminal elements convene - are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

The local authorities are working on tracking down these illegal ports, but until they succeed trade on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] will suffer.

texts.zh: 尽管令人讨厌，但这种非法活动的枢纽将为我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]提供丰富的遗传多样性研究。
texts.en: Although a nuisance, such a nexus of illicit activity will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with an abundance of genetic diversity to study.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
[GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
真不幸。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的犯罪率近期有大幅度的提升，而[Root.GetPlanetMoon]也几乎要变成不法之地了。最近的犯罪目标基本上都是住宅区域，此前我们都认为住宅区位于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]当地最大犯罪团伙的活动范围之外。
texts.en: There has been a recent upswing in crime on [Root.GetName], as the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] continues its descent into lawlessness. This latest crime wave has targeted residential areas that up until now had been considered outside of the influence of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant criminal gangs.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]还安全地呆在实验室里，准备迎接新一批实验对象的涌入。
texts.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] remain safe within secure labs, and are preparing for an influx of new test subjects.

label.zh: 这些犯罪分子给了我们许多值得研究的东西。
label.en: These criminal elements give us much to study.

label.zh: 这些犯罪分子给了我们许多值得研究的东西。
label.en: These criminal elements give us much to study.

label.zh: 一定要制止这种犯罪行为。
label.en: The crime situation must be dealt with.

texts.zh: 在接到匿名线人的线索后，[Root.GetName]警方全力出动，围剿了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]首都外围的大型仓库。警方在仓库内发现了大量违禁走私物品，据调查后发现其属于当地的犯罪组织。在将部分组织成员逮捕后，警方没收了所有违禁走私物品，并将其储存在政府库存之中。
texts.en: Following up on an anonymous tip, Enforcers on [Root.GetName] recently stormed a large warehouse on the outskirts of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s capital. Inside they found a considerable stash of contraband, evidently stored here by a local criminal organization. Several arrests have been made, and the impounded contraband is now safely stored in government depots.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们迫不及待地想把这批非法物质编入目录，并期望在进一步的实验中得到巨大的发现。
texts.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to catalogue this trove of illicit substances, and anticipate great discoveries from their applied use in further experiments.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
[GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
棒极了。

texts.zh: 在一次执法者突击行动中，[Root.GetName]的首要犯罪头目终于落网。随着其头目的消失，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]大型犯罪团伙减少了犯罪活动，当地的犯罪率也因此下降。
texts.en: An important crime boss on [Root.GetName] was recently caught in an Enforcer sting operation. The loss of their leader has severely curtailed the activities of one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s major criminal organizations, leading to a marked decrease in crime.

texts.zh: 这次收获给我们带来研究一种备受推崇的罪犯心理的独特机会。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫切希望进行侵入式分析。
texts.en: Such an acquisition gives us a unique opportunity for the study of a highly regarded criminal mind. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to begin intrusive analysis.

label.zh: 我们能发现很有趣的秘密。
label.en: What interesting secrets we shall learn.

label.zh: 我们能发现很有趣的秘密。
label.en: What interesting secrets we shall learn.

label.zh: 棒极了。

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上处于龙头的两个犯罪组织几个月来一直处于兵刃相见、势不两立的局面，而现在全面战争终于爆发了。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大街小巷中都是刀光剑影，而许多住宅区域也未能幸免。

当地安保部队正在尽全力遏制暴力事件的发生，但由于犯罪组织人数众多，尚未能见成效。
texts.en:
A bitter feud has been brewing for months between the two largest criminal organizations on [Root.GetName], and it has now finally come to a head. Vicious fighting has erupted in streets and alleys across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and it is rapidly spreading into residential areas.

Our local security forces are doing what they can to contain the violence, but the sheer scale of the fighting has left them overwhelmed.

texts.zh: 这样的环境给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们留下了大量的实验材料。他们说，福祸相依嘛。
texts.en: Such an environment has left our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with a backlog of experimentation material. Every cloud, as they say.

label.zh: 那里已经变成了战场！

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的犯罪组织之一最近对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的执法人员进行了一系列伏击。在同一时间内，帮派成员伏击了各地的巡逻警官，有多个警区已经完全落入犯罪组织的手中。此次大型作案造成数千人死亡。

剩余的执法人员团队由于人手严重不足以难以维持局面。目前[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的许多区域已经完全沦陷，情况十分危急。
texts.en:
One of the gangs on [Root.GetName] recently launched a concerted attack on law enforcement officers all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. At a given hour, gang members ambushed patrolling Enforcers while several precincts were completely overrun. The intense fighting has left thousands dead.

Our remaining security forces are struggling to regain control, but for the time being many regions of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have descended into utter lawlessness.

texts.zh: 这样的犯罪行为至少让我们可以给[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们送去充足的供给。
texts.en: Such criminality at least grants us a surplus of fresh supplies for our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural].

label.zh: [GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
[GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
这可不妙。

title.en: Gang Wars on [Root.GetName] Spread Into Space

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上黑帮火并引发的动乱已经扩散到[Root.solar_system.GetName]星系的其余部分。据报道，两伙人已用武装民船战了几场。双方都在打劫贸易船以获得资金及扩大舰队。
texts.en: The violent gang war that has been raging on [Root.GetName] has spread to the rest of the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system. There have been reports of several clashes between armed civilian ships flying gang colors, and both sides of the war are going after incoming trade vessels with the goal of securing more income and expanding their fleets.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]申请观察报复的后果以及大量尸体抛入真空的大规模实例。
texts.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have requested that they be allowed to observe the aftermath of our retaliation and the large-scale instance of corpses mass-ejected into the vacuum of space.

label.zh: 我们的报复将会相当有教育意义。
label.en: Our retaliation will be most educational.

tooltips.zh: 一支敌对海盗舰队已出现在了[Root.solar_system.GetName]星系！
tooltips.en: A hostile pirate fleet has appeared in the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system!

label.zh: 我们的报复将会相当有教育意义。
label.en: Our retaliation will be most educational.

label.zh: 这可不妙。

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的两个主要黑社会帮派最近在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的城市中心进行了十分血腥的战斗。双方死亡人数已有数万人，但最终仍没有分出输赢。

这场残酷的战斗几乎将整个城市都夷为平地，城市中的大部分居民都被迫逃走了。
texts.en:
A pitched battle between the two major gangs of [Root.GetName] was recently waged in one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s largest urban centers. The body count is in the tens of thousands on both sides, and there was no clear winner.

The savage fighting razed the city nearly to the ground, and most of its population were forced to flee.

texts.zh: 这种无端的暴力也不是毫无魅力可言。也许还能从死者身上抢救出新的科学研究成果。
texts.en: Such senseless violence is not without its charms. We may yet be able to salvage new scientific research from the deceased.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
[GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
令人不安。

title.zh: 帮派战争对商业活动造成影响
title.en: Traders Steer Clear Of Gang Wars

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的帮派战争仍然持续不断，并且对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的商业贸易产生了十分负面的影响。鉴于当前的状况，不少星际贸易公会都颁布了对此行星的旅行警告，建议商人们不要前往[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。不过与其同时，走私军火的生意倒是火得不行。
texts.en: The ongoing struggle between the gangs on [Root.GetName] has had a negative impact on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s trade. With the volatile situation on the surface, several interstellar merchant guilds have issued a travel advisory warning traders to stay away from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The trafficking of illegal arms seems to be booming, however.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]将这些强力的武器带到大街小巷上，迫不及待想测试它们对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]身体的破坏力。
texts.en: With such powerful weaponry making its way onto the streets, our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to examine their damaging effects on the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] body.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
[GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
令人担忧。

texts.zh:
随着[Root.GetName]犯罪活动的日益猖獗，非法药品的买卖数量也达到了历史新高。全宇宙最有名的各种毒品在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能找得到。

对于这里的人民来说，使用毒品已经成为稀松平常的事情了。这对于生产力来说无疑是个灾难。
texts.en:
With crime running rampant on [Root.GetName], the sale of illegal narcotics has also increased to new record levels. A wide variety of addictive drugs from all over known space is now being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

Drug use has become widespread among the population, to the detriment of general productivity.

texts.zh: 这种新兴的犯罪活动应该会为我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来令人兴奋的新研究途径。
texts.en: This emerging criminal activity should lend our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] an exciting new avenue of study.

label.zh: 什么罪犯？那叫志愿者！

这可不妙。

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的走私犯们带来了一种全新的毒品，似乎来自于文明世界之外的太空海盗领域。这种毒品不仅极易成瘾，而且对绝大多数生命形态而言，用量稍微过高就能够致命。

虽然当地政府正在竭尽全力阻止这种致命毒品继续传播，但[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的死亡率却一直在攀升。
texts.en:
Smugglers on [Root.GetName] have introduced a new drug that we believe originated from somewhere in the pirate territories beyond civilized space. This drug is not only highly addictive, but it has also proven quite lethal to most life forms if consumed in anything but small quantities.

While local authorities are doing what they can to stem the spread of this drug, there has been a rash of deaths all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh: 无论如何，我们已经通过研究这些物质及其对实验对象的影响获得了一些令人惊叹的研究进展。
texts.en: In any case, we have observed some fascinating developments in our research through the study of this substance and its effects on test subjects.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
[GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
令人担忧。

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]做生意的各大犯罪寡头们在毒品市场中一直处于激烈的竞争，但最近其竞争终于擦出了火花。据报告，贩毒团伙的成员们使用军用武器进行了数次冲突，造成了大量财产损失，且有众多无辜平民伤亡。看来走私进[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的不只有毒品而已。
texts.en: Competition for markets is fierce between the criminal cartels that are involved in the drug trade on [Root.GetName]. There have been several recent clashes involving heavy military-grade infantry weapons that caused considerable property damage and left untold civilians dead. It would seem drugs aren't the only thing being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh: [GetExperimentersEmergingCrime]
texts.en: [GetExperimentersEmergingCrime]

label.zh: 天灾啊！

texts.zh:
一艘大型民用运输舰船在申请进入[Root.GetName]大气层停靠后，其申请因在货舱查出非法毒品而被拒绝。当地政府想要对舰船进行进一步搜索时，舰船的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]舰长因为吸食毒品过量，企图冲击轨道防线，强行进行着陆。

运输船在下降时被我方行星保安部队击中，导致其坠毁在人口十分密集的城市地区。事发现场几乎没有任何的幸存者。
texts.en:
A large civilian freighter was recently denied atmospheric entry on [Root.GetName] after it was found to be carrying illegal drugs in an auxiliary cargo compartment. As the freighter was ordered to heave to for inspection, its captain, a drug-crazed [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], instead opted to burn past the orbital blockade in an attempt to land.

The freighter was hit by ground fire from our planetside security forces as it descended, causing it to crash into a densely populated city district. There were few survivors on the ground.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想研究那些散布到周围社区环境中的毒品的影响。
texts.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to study the effects of the narcotics that have since dissipated into the environment in the surrounding communities.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
[GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
天灾啊！

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的非法毒品交易仍然十分猖獗。最近我们接到报告，说走私犯们想尽办法，侵入了我方轨道中的异星天然气仓库，并窃取了数种具有致幻效果的气体。这些气体随即便被药贩子们在[Root.GetName]的阴暗小巷中贩卖。
texts.en: The illicit drug trade continues unabated on [Root.GetName]. We recently discovered that smugglers have somehow pilfered Exotic Gases from one of our orbital storage yards, singling out those gases with known psychedelic properties. They were then distributed to dealers and sold in the back alleys of [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]惊讶于他们一开始竟然没想到异星天然气的这些妙用。
texts.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are surprised they didn't think of these clever applications of Exotic Gases first.

label.zh: 真是有趣。
真是有趣。
不能这么下去了！
label.en: This can't be allowed to continue!

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上最大的犯罪组织日前终于消灭了其在行星上的所有竞争对手，成为了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]庞大犯罪集团的唯一领袖。一直以来他们都在暗中破坏行星政府的权威，而当地人也早已经把他们当成了[Root.GetName]的真正统治者。
texts.en: The dominant crime syndicate on [Root.GetName] recently eliminated the last of its competitors and achieved complete control over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s extensive criminal underworld. They have long since undermined the real planetary authorities, and the local population now look upon these gangsters as the true rulers of [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们认定这颗行星对未来研究而言具有“资产丰富”的环境。
texts.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have designated this planet an "asset rich" environment for future research.

label.zh: 一定收拾一下这些小毛贼。
label.en: These thugs must be dealt with.

texts.zh: 控制[Root.GetName]区域的犯罪组织规划了十分庞大的保护费收取网。由于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]政府与执法系统对于有组织的犯罪行为束手无策，人民也只能屈服于该犯罪组织，以保自身平安。这也导致了该区域的生产力也连连下降。
texts.en: The gangsters controlling [Root.GetName] have instituted an extensive protection racket. Since the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s true judicial and law enforcement systems have proved unable to deal with organized crime, the population feels that it has no choice but to submit to the authority of these criminals. This has had a serious effect on productivity.

texts.zh: 从积极的角度看，这些帮派似乎在给[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们提供实验对象的方面比更正规一些的渠道都还有效。
texts.en: On a positive note, these gangsters tend to be more efficient at providing our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with test subjects than more official channels.

label.zh: 然而，我们还是应该致力于重建秩序。
label.en: Still, we should work to reestablish control.

label.zh: 然而，我们还是应该致力于重建秩序。
label.en: Still, we should work to reestablish control.

label.zh: 我们需要重新掌控这片区域。

texts.zh:
对[Root.GetName]最近实地调查显示，该行星政府的大部分成员都受雇于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的犯罪组织。虽然涉事官员已经全部被调换，但这也打破了该区域的一向秩序。

此外，[Root.GetName]的地下统治者现在也在加紧收买刚上任的新官员们……
texts.en:
A recent fact-finding mission to [Root.GetName] revealed that the vast majority of the planetary administration was in the employ of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant crime syndicate. The corrupt officials in question have all been replaced, but this has led to significant disruptions in the public sector.

In addition, the gangsters that rule the criminal underworld of [Root.GetName] are even now trying to bribe or coerce the new officials into their organization.

texts.zh: [GetExperimentersEmergingCrime]
texts.en: [GetExperimentersEmergingCrime]

label.zh: 暂时的挫折。
施行零容忍政策。
激励诚实者。
和平主义

texts.zh:
进行暗杀的成员来自[Root.GetName]最有权势的犯罪组织，而他们暗杀的正是[governor_target.GetTitle][governor_target.GetName]！在[governor_target.GetTitle]的车队离开太空港时，被犯罪组织所拦截。护卫队伍与暗杀成员们进行了激烈的交火。

当战斗结束后，我们获得消息确认[governor_target.GetTitle]因公殉职了。
texts.en:
Gangsters from the criminal syndicate that dominates the underworld on [Root.GetName] have assassinated [governor_target.GetTitle] [governor_target.GetName]! The [governor_target.GetTitle]'s motorcade was cut off as it left the spaceport, and an intense firefight flared up between the escorting security detachment and the attacking gangsters.

When the dust settled, the [governor_target.GetTitle] was confirmed to have been among the dead.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
[GetExperimentersTragicLesson]
准备国葬。

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]称霸的犯罪组织目前控制了大部分进出[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的交易。他们完全掌控了几大太空港对所有进出的货物雁过拔毛。因此，[Root.GetName]的贸易利润急剧下降。
texts.en: The crime syndicate running [Root.GetName] now controls a significant portion of the trade to and from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They have established total control over several major spaceports, where all trade must go through their intermediaries. As a result, our trade incomes from [Root.GetName] are down across the board.

texts.zh: 幸运的是，我们[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]用的补给线并未受到影响，可能是因为贿赂到位了才保住的实验对象。
texts.en: Fortunately, the supply lines used by our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] remain unaffected, likely due to the bribes already in place to secure test subjects.

label.zh: 科学大步跨进。
科学大步跨进。
真是令人忍无可忍。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]最近出现了大量反常子个体到处攻击忠诚的子个体并破坏设施。这些反常子个体对我们造成了极大的损失后最终被击退。
texts.en: A large number of deviant drones recently stampeded across [Root.GetName], attacking loyal drones and damaging our facilities. The deviants inflicted significant damage before they could be driven away.

label.zh: 必须处理掉这些反常分子。
label.en: These deviants must be dealt with.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上出现的反常子个体的数量日益壮大，开始对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生产效率造成了明显的影响。这些反常分子不断地干扰我们的子个体的工作，偷走必要的工具及设备。
texts.en: The presence of an increasing number of deviant drones on [Root.GetName] has begun to have a detrimental effect on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s production efficiency. As our drones go about their business, the deviants frequently get in the way or steal needed tools and equipment.

texts.zh: 这种反常行为只会使我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]在科学追求中有更多的选择。
texts.en: Such deviancy only furthers the options available to our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] in their scientific pursuits.

label.zh: [GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
[GetExperimentersWeWillLearn]
必须处理掉这些反常分子。
label.en: These deviants must be dealt with.

texts.zh: 反常分子中极具影响力的某个子个体最近一直活跃于[Root.GetName]上进行骚乱活动，最终成功被正常子个体干掉。此子个体的死亡严重影响了其他反常子个体的行动，这意味着该子个体是个重要的首脑。
texts.en: One of the more influential drones among the deviants that have been agitating and causing trouble on [Root.GetName] was recently cornered and killed by loyalist drones. The death of this drone appears to have severely curtailed the activities of the other deviants, indicating its role as an important ringleader.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]注意到了对这个颇具影响力的异常子个体的解剖价值。期望能从这具了无生气的躯壳中学到很多东西。
texts.en: The value in dissecting this influential deviant has been noted by our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]. We expect to learn much from their lifeless vessel.

label.zh: 它们死后也还是在为蜂巢服务。
label.en: They will serve the Hive even in death.

label.zh: 它们死后也还是在为蜂巢服务。
label.en: They will serve the Hive even in death.

label.zh: 蜂巢的意志是绝对的。
label.en: The will of the Hive Mind is absolute.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的某个大型腐化无人机网络最近将所有[Root.Owner.GetName]认定为敌对单位。这些无人机发动袭击对我们造成了极大的破坏，最后才成功被我们的安保单位彻底击退。
texts.en: One of the larger networks of corrupted drone units on [Root.GetName] recently designated the entirety of the [Root.Owner.GetName] as hostile. These drones went on a rampage and caused considerable damage before our loyal security units succeeded in either destroying or driving them off.

label.zh: 不能就这么算了。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的腐化无人机网络开始干扰正常单位的工作了。对方所散播的信号几乎完全掩盖了核心智能的指令，导致我们的工作无人机行动卡顿，错误操作时常出现。
texts.en: The corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName] have started to interfere with the operation of our functional units. Their signals are drowning out those of the core intelligence, resulting in sluggish and sometimes erratic behavior on the part of our worker drones.

label.zh: 不能就这么算了。

title.zh: 病毒消灭了[Root.GetName]上的腐化无人机网络

texts.zh: 对[Root.GetName]上的某个腐化无人机网络的病毒攻击成功将其完全格式化。这使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上腐化无人机的活动大幅减少。
texts.en: A virus introduced into one of the corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName] has successfully terminated its entire data grid. This has significantly reduced the activities of all corrupted drone units on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

label.zh: 定将贯彻核心智能的指令。
label.en: The directives of the core intelligence will be upheld.

texts.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]上的犯罪率大幅降低，曾经横行[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的犯罪集团也都被一一瓦解了。当地人民终于迎来了久违的安宁和谐的生活。
texts.en: With the significant reduction of crime on [Root.GetName], the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s once pervasive criminal underworld has been reduced to nothingness. The population has been imbued with a renewed sense of safety and harmony.

texts.zh: 秩序恢复一新，我们期待能顺利回归到富有成效的研究中。
texts.en: With this newfound order, we expect a triumphant return to productive study.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上子个体的叛乱行为已成功被铲除。蜂巢思维的意志重新得到稳固。
texts.en: Deviant drone activity has been successfully stomped out on [Root.GetName]. The supreme will of the Hive Mind has reasserted itself.

texts.zh: 死去的反常子个体可以让我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们进行充分利用。
texts.en: The expired deviants will serve our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] well in death.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的所有腐化无人机已被彻底净化干净。所有无人机单位都在核心智能的指令下正常的运作。
texts.en: The drone corruption that was formerly present on [Root.GetName] has been purged from all networks. All drone units are once again operating according to the parameters established by the core intelligence.

label.zh: 科学大步跨进。
科学大步跨进。
好。

# 恶贯满盈 / Scum and Villainy

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/crime_events.txt:3-2606; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:244,3933-3941 on_yearly_pulse / on_colony_yearly_pulse · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

殖民地每年脉冲（on_colony_yearly_pulse，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3938-3939）以25/100的权重抽中 crime.40“黑社会出现”：犯罪值≥30、人口>0、没有任何失业救济/待机模式等抑制修正，且不在冷却期。反之 crime.41“秩序恢复”在犯罪降低时消除黑社会。

The colony yearly pulse (on_colony_yearly_pulse, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3938-3939) can draw crime.40 "Scum and Villainy" with weight 25/100: planet crime >= 30, pops present, no suppressing modifier (unemployment benefits, standby mode ...) and not in cooldown. crime.41 "Order Restored" removes the underworld when crime falls again.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

crime.40 的选项按帝国类型不同：a 普通帝国、b 蜂巢“偏离蜂群”、c 机器“腐化”；选项会给星球加犯罪修正（criminal_underworld / drone_deviancy / drone_corruption）。此后国家年度脉冲（on_yearly_pulse，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:244）触发门卫 crime.50，按帝国类型转 crime.51（普通）、.52（蜂巢）、.53（机器），在有犯罪修正的星球上随机抽小事件：普通帝国 crime.2–8（生活化事件）或升级为 crime.100“帮派战争”、crime.200“毒品交易扩大”、crime.300“黑道统治”，每条升级线再有 4 个后续（101–104、201–204、301–304）；蜂巢为 crime.500–502（偏差无人机），机器为 crime.550–552（腐化无人机）。

crime.40 has options by empire type: a ordinary, b hive "strayed from the Hive Mind", c machine "corruption"; the options set the planet's crime modifier (criminal_underworld / drone_deviancy / drone_corruption). From then on the yearly country pulse (on_yearly_pulse, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:244) fires the gatekeeper crime.50, which routes to crime.51 (ordinary), .52 (hive) or .53 (machine) and draws a random event on a planet with a crime modifier: ordinary empires get crime.2-8 (everyday events) or escalate to crime.100 "Gang Wars", crime.200 "Drug Trade Expands" or crime.300 "Mob Rule", each escalation with four follow-ups (101-104, 201-204, 301-304); hives get crime.500-502 (deviant drones), machines crime.550-552 (corrupted drones).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

每次抽取的权重是：不发生300（普通）/200（蜂巢、机器），其余每个事件10（部分5）。三条升级线互斥——每个星球一次只带一个修正；crime.303（总督被刺杀）只在黑道统治且有总督、该国家尚未被刺杀过、总督不是传奇/天选者时才能抽到。大多数窗口的实验者（twisted experimenters）文明有专属选项文字。

Each draw has weight 300 (ordinary) or 200 (hive, machine) for nothing and 10 (sometimes 5) for each event. The three escalation lines are exclusive - a planet carries one modifier at a time; crime.303 (governor assassinated) needs Mob Rule, a governor, no earlier assassination for the country and a non-legendary, non-chosen-one governor. Twisted Experimenters empires have their own option text in most windows.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

crime.1“失业率攀升”是已被禁用的旧事件，见 unreachable 记录。

crime.1 "Rising Unemployment" is a disabled legacy event (see the unreachable record).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对入口、触发、选项与结果。
  Checked the entry, trigger, options and outcomes.
- （以上为审阅者撰写的说明，不是游戏原文；原文见阅读页。）
  (Commentary written by the reviewer, not game text; the original text is in the reader.)
